steps.name: three-queued-then-one-ready
steps.detail: Ran `ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at10-alpha ATM_TEAM=fx-at10 atm task assign fx-at10-beta ... --task-id c1-{1,2,3}-1792636619 --json`; each returned {"task_id":...}. (First attempt with `--as fx-at10-alpha` on assign returned 'identity is not configured'; the env prefix works.) After each assignment, `atm list --pending-ack --json` as beta returned count 0 and bucket_counts.pending_ack 0 (three separate runs: unread 1/2/3, pending_ack 0, 0, 0). `atm task list --json` as beta: c1-1 position 1, c1-2 position 2, c1-3 position 3, all state assigned. `atm task events <id> --json`: each shows event assigned + handoff kind task_queued; after one poll c1-1 shows event reminded + handoff {"kind":"task_ready","task_id":"c1-1-1792636619","trigger":"task_pass"}; c1-2 and c1-3 show only assigned/task_queued (exactly one ready task).

steps.name: close-releases-next
steps.detail: As beta: `atm task start c1-1-1792636619 --json` -> outcome sent, summary 'started c1-1-1792636619'; `atm task close c1-1-1792636619 completed done --json` -> outcome sent, summary 'done'. Poll 6 (about 6s): `atm task events c1-2-1792636619 --json` shows event reminded at 2026-10-22T02:37:10.574Z and handoff {"kind":"task_ready","task_id":"c1-2-1792636619","trigger":"task_pass"}; `atm task list --json` shows c1-2 position 1, c1-3 position 2.

steps.name: reassign-notifies-both
steps.detail: Alpha assigned c3a/c3b-1792636639 to beta, then ran `atm task assign fx-at10-gamma "c3 second reassigned" --task-id c3b-1792636639 --json` (the CLI has no dedicated reassign command; re-assigning an existing task id reassigns it). `atm task events c3b-1792636639 --json`: event {"event":"reassigned","assignee":"fx-at10-gamma","seq":2}; handoffs: {"agent":"fx-at10-beta","kind":"task_closed","message_key":"atm:01M5GQGPNWN2Q4RVD102F90APC"}, {"agent":"fx-at10-gamma","kind":"task_queued"}, later {"agent":"fx-at10-gamma","kind":"task_ready"}. Beta `atm list --all --task c3b-1792636639 --json` shows row summary 'task_closed:c3b-1792636639' from alpha; `atm read --message-id 01M5GQGPNWN2Q4RVD102F90APC --json` as beta: text 'task c3b-1792636639 was reassigned to fx-at10-gamma'. Gamma `atm task list --json`: c3b state assigned, position 1.

steps.name: move-head-readies-once
steps.detail: Alpha assigned c4a-1792636650 then c4b-1792636650 to beta; c4a showed task_ready after 6 polls. `atm task move c4b-1792636650 --head --json` (as beta) -> {"task_id":"c4b-1792636650","assignee":"fx-at10-beta","from":2,"to":1}. After 12s: c4a events/handoffs = assigned, reminded, task_queued, task_ready (one task_ready); c4b = assigned, moved, reminded, task_queued, task_ready (one task_ready). `atm task list --json`: c4b position 1, c4a position 2.

steps.name: cancel-notifies-assignee
steps.detail: Alpha assigned c5a/c5b-1792636671 to beta (c5b queued behind c5a). `atm task close c5b-1792636671 cancelled --json` as alpha was rejected: 'a close <id> <outcome> needs a reason or a report source'; retried with a reason: `atm task close c5b-1792636671 cancelled "cancelled by alpha" --json` -> {"agent":"fx-at10-beta","sender":"fx-at10-alpha","outcome":"sent","message_id":"01M5GQHTFWS80D0C7TV9B9VQAM","task_id":"c5b-1792636671","summary":"cancelled by alpha"}. Beta `atm task events c5b-1792636671 --json` shows event "cancelled" and handoff {"agent":"fx-at10-beta","kind":"task_closed","message_key":"atm:01M5GQHTFWS80D0C7TV9B9VQAM"}; beta `atm list --all --task c5b-1792636671` includes message_id 01M5GQHTFWS80D0C7TV9B9VQAM, summary 'cancelled by alpha'.

steps.name: busy-assigner-sees-terminal-lines
steps.detail: Gamma assigned c6a-1792636684 to alpha (the prompt does not say who assigns alpha) and alpha ran `atm task start c6a-1792636684 --json`. Alpha `atm task list --json`: {"task_id":"c6a-1792636684","assignee":"fx-at10-alpha","state":"active","position":1}. Then alpha assigned c6b-1792636684 to beta; beta ran `atm task start` and `atm task close c6b-1792636684 completed done`. Alpha `atm list --all --json` rows for c6b-1792636684: summary 'started c6b-1792636684' at 2026-10-22T02:38:04.290262516Z, then summary 'done' at 2026-10-22T02:38:04.295430252Z, both from fx-at10-beta, in that order.

steps.name: cleanup
steps.detail: Every task was closed with `atm task close` at the end of its case, and c6a was closed last with `atm task close c6a-1792636684 completed done --json` (outcome sent). Final `atm task list --json` as alpha, beta and gamma each returned []. An early probe task (probe3-1792636615) was also closed as cancelled.
